messages:
carol: Quick note — spotted an inconsistency in api-ref/files.md for the upload endpoint. cURL example uses multipart/form-data but the Python and Node snippets show a JSON payload with base64. That's going to confuse customers and lint.

ben: ouch. which endpoint exactly?

carol: POST /v1/files/upload (under 'Examples'). cURL: `-F file=@report.pdf` but Python snippet: `payload = {\"filename\": \"report.pdf\", \"content_b64\": \"...\"}` then `requests.post(..., json=payload)`.

alice: runtime still supports both shapes for backcompat but we want to standardize on multipart for docs — it's simpler and matches browser/form uploads. We should: 1) make canonical examples show multipart, 2) show a small migration note for base64 JSON consumers, 3) update SDK snippets to use the multipart helper in the official SDK.

ben: agree. Two small catches: the OpenAPI schema currently declares `requestBody: content: application/json` only. If we change examples to multipart, linter will fail unless we add `multipart/form-data` to the spec. Is that acceptable?

alice: yes, we should update the OpenAPI file to include `multipart/form-data` (schema: type: object, properties: file: type: string, format: binary, filename: string optional). We'll still keep the JSON shape documented for migration but mark it deprecated in the text.

carol: PR time? I can open the docs PR with example changes and the deprecation note. Want me to also tweak the OpenAPI?

ben: I'll handle the OpenAPI patch — will add the multipart media type and a short description: "Preferred: multipart/form-data with binary file field. JSON base64 shape accepted for legacy clients; deprecated." Also update examples in openapi/examples.

alice: don't forget codeblock language hints (```bash, ```python, ```js) — CI lint loves those.

docs-bot: Linked PRs: docs https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/612 , openapi https://github.com/redwood-inference/openapi/pull/88 . Docs CI: failing (example-schema-check).

carol: failing because openapi change not merged yet so docs linter still validates examples against old spec. ben, once you open the openapi PR can you request docs CI re-run?

ben: openapi PR created and linked. Added `multipart/form-data` and updated schema examples. Also added a tiny note in schema description: "Preferred: multipart; JSON base64 accepted for now (deprecated)."

sdk-ci: sdk-snippets mismatch: sdk examples still show json/base64 for the FileUpload helper.

alice: I'll update sdk-snippets to use the SDK's file upload helper which posts multipart. Will add tests ensuring generated docs include the multipart snippet for each language. PR incoming.

carol: in docs PR I'll include both forms for clarity: canonical multipart example first, then a small "Legacy JSON (base64)" example with a migration note. Keep the legacy example fenced and clearly labelled.

docs-bot: docs PR re-run: now failing (excerpt-check) — codeblock language missing in one of the legacy examples.

carol: fixing quickly — adding ```json hint for the legacy snippet and adjusting wording. Pushing now.

docs-bot: docs PR CI: passing. openapi PR CI: passing. sdk-snippets PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-snippets/pull/314 created, CI: failing (test: snippet-presence).

alice: test failure because our generated docs runner expects the exact example string `Content-Type: multipart/form-data` and the SDK helper sets a boundary; the test should assert presence of `multipart/form-data` instead of the full header. Updating test to use substring match.

alice: updated sdk-snippets test and snippet to use the multipart helper in python/js/go. Re-ran CI.

sdk-ci: sdk-snippets PR CI: passing.

ben: now that all three PRs are green, we should add a changelog entry: docs/CHANGELOG.md -> "files: standardized uploads to multipart/form-data; legacy JSON base64 examples deprecated (openapi + SDK updated)." Also add an infra ticket reference for when we'll start returning deprecation warnings in traces (INF-901).

carol: added changelog line in the docs PR. merging now. :shipit:

alice: thanks — will follow up with an SDK release note and a short blog blurb for migration.

carol: closing loop: Verified staging docs show multipart example for curl/python/node and have the legacy JSON block below with the deprecation note. All good.

ben: thanks team. One tiny followup: add a short line in the API reference about expected server behavior for missing filename (server will infer filename from Content-Disposition; for JSON shape filename field required). I filed a small docs issue to capture that.

carol: noted and added link to issue in PR description.
